question: Are the exercise-book contracts in federal constituency projects priced fairly compared with what states pay?

plan.name: collect_federal_contracts
plan.description: Retrieve all federal constituency project contracts for exercise books

plan.name: collect_state_contracts
plan.description: Retrieve state-level exercise book procurement contracts

plan.name: standardize_specifications
plan.description: Normalize book specs into comparable tiers
plan.rule: Create specification tiers (e.g., Tier 1: 80 leaves, 60gsm, hardcover; Tier 2: 60 leaves, 55gsm, softcover)

plan.name: calculate_price_per_book
plan.description: Compute unit price for each contract line
plan.rule: unit_price_ngn = total_value_ngn / quantity_books; flag if quantity_books = 0 or unit_price_ngn > 3x tier median

plan.name: cpi_deflation
plan.description: Adjust all prices to constant 2024 NGN using Nigeria CPI

plan.name: deduplicate_contracts
plan.rule: Keep first occurrence; log duplicates with reason (exact match, same supplier+year+qty+price)

plan.name: identify_twin_awards
plan.description: Flag contracts with identical/near-identical terms awarded to different suppliers or same supplier in same period

plan.name: benchmark_analysis
plan.description: Compare federal vs state real unit prices by specification tier

toolCalls.sql: SELECT c.id, c.main_ocid, c.main_id, c.title, c.dateSigned, c.value_amount, c.value_currency FROM bpp_pg.bpp_contracts c WHERE lower(c.title) LIKE '%exercise book%' OR lower(c.title) LIKE '%notebook%' OR lower(c.title) LIKE '%note book%' ORDER BY c.dateSigned DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT c.id, c.main_ocid, c.main_id, c.title, c.dateSigned, c.value_amount, c.value_currency, i.id, i.quantity, i.description, i.contracts_id FROM bpp_pg.bpp_contracts c JOIN bpp_pg.bpp_contracts_items i ON i.main_ocid = c.main_ocid AND i.main_id = c.main_id AND i.contracts_id = c.id WHERE (lower(c.title) LIKE '%exercise book%' OR lower(c.title) LIKE '%notebook%' OR lower(c.title) LIKE '%note book%') ORDER BY c.dateSigned DESC, c.id DESC, i.id

SELECT ocid, id, date, tender_title, tender_value_amount, tender_value_currency, buyer_name, tender_procuringEntity_name FROM states_pg.oyo_main WHERE lower(tender_title) LIKE '%exercise book%' OR lower(tender_title) LIKE '%notebook%' OR lower(tender_title) LIKE '%note book%' ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
SELECT date, value, indicator_id, indicator_name FROM states_pg.world_bank_cpi WHERE countryiso3code = 'NGA' AND value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT b.name AS supplier, count(DISTINCT b.main_ocid) AS bpp_awards, count(DISTINCT o.main_ocid) AS osun_awards FROM bpp_pg.bpp_awards_suppliers b JOIN states_pg.osun_awards_suppliers o ON upper(trim(b.name)) = upper(trim(o.name)) GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY bpp_awards DESC

I need to create a concise JSON plan with steps and data requirements. The prior vetted answer was quite detailed but I should write a fresh answer, not copy verbatim. I'll structure it clearly with steps covering the four areas mentioned.

Let me create a focused plan.</think>{

    {
      "step": 1,
      "name": "collect_federal_contracts",
      "description": "Retrieve all federal constituency project contracts for exercise books",
      "data_needed": [
        "contract_id",
        "constituency",
        "state",
        "award_year",
        "supplier_name",
        "quantity_books",
        "total_value_ngn",
        "book_specification"
      ],
      "sources": ["NOCOPO portal", "BPP awards database", "constituency project tracking sheets"]
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "name": "collect_state_contracts",
      "description": "Retrieve state-level exercise book procurement contracts",
      "data_needed": [
        "contract_id",
        "state",
        "award_year",
        "supplier_name",
        "quantity_books",
        "total_value_ngn",
        "book_specification"
      ],
      "sources": ["state procurement portals", "SUBEB records", "state ministry of education tenders"]
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "name": "standardize_specifications",
      "description": "Normalize book specs into comparable tiers",
      "data_needed": [
        "page_count",
        "paper_gsm",
        "cover_type",
        "size",
        "binding_type"
      ],
      "rule": "Create specification tiers (e.g., Tier 1: 80 leaves, 60gsm, hardcover; Tier 2: 60 leaves, 55gsm, softcover)"
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "name": "calculate_price_per_book",
      "description": "Compute unit price for each contract line",
      "inputs": ["total_value_ngn", "quantity_books"],
      "output": "unit_price_ngn",
      "rule": "unit_price_ngn = total_value_ngn / quantity_books; flag if quantity_books = 0 or unit_price_ngn > 3x tier median"
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "name": "cpi_deflation",
      "description": "Adjust all prices to constant 2024 NGN using Nigeria CPI",
      "data_needed": [
        "award_year",
        "unit_price_ngn",
        "cpi_annual_average"
      ],
      "base_year": 2024,
      "source": "NBS CPI series",
      "rule": "real_price_2024 = unit_price_ngn * (CPI_2024 / CPI_award_year)"
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "name": "deduplicate_contracts",
      "description": "Remove duplicate contract records",
      "keys": ["contract_id", "supplier_name", "award_year", "quantity_books", "unit_price_ngn"],
      "rule": "Keep first occurrence; log duplicates with reason (exact match, same supplier+year+qty+price)"
    },
    {
      "step": 7,
      "name": "identify_twin_awards",
      "description": "Flag contracts with identical/near-identical terms awarded to different suppliers or same supplier in same period",
      "match_fields": ["constituency_or_state", "award_year", "spec_tier", "quantity_books"],
      "thresholds": {
        "quantity_tolerance_pct": 5,
        "price_tolerance_pct": 10
      },
      "output": "twin_award_flag, twin_group_id"
    },
    {
      "step": 8,
      "name": "benchmark_analysis",
      "description": "Compare federal vs state real unit prices by specification tier",
      "group_by": ["spec_tier", "award_year"],
      "metrics": ["median_real_price_2024", "p25", "p75", "count"],
      "comparison": "federal_median vs state_median per tier-year"
    }
  ]
}

Looking at the evidence:
- Federal contracts: various leaf counts (20, 40, 60, 80, 100 leaves), some include "SUPPLY AND DISTRIBUTION" in title, some "PRINTING AND SUPPLY". Quantities range from 8,200 to 74,000. Years 2021-2024.
- Oyo contracts: mostly 60 or 80 leaves, very large quantities (200,000+), from 2019-2022. The median 558.15 comes from 2019 lots (deflated).

- Different specifications: Federal includes 100-leaf books, Oyo only 60/80 leaves
- Different years: Federal 2023-2024, Oyo 2019-2022 (though CPI adjusted)
- Distribution included: Some federal explicitly say "SUPPLY AND DISTRIBUTION", Oyo may not include distribution
- Economies of scale: Oyo orders 200k+ per lot, federal orders 8k-74k
- Customization level: Federal says "CUSTOMIZED" frequently, Oyo also customized but maybe different
- Geographic spread: Federal to specific constituencies/LGAs, Oyo to state-wide schools
- Paper quality, cover weight, colour printing differences not captured in leaf count

This could be a downgrade - the gap may have legitimate explanations.

- Separate lots for different schools/areas (Tudun vs Galadimawa)
- Different awardees (not shown in evidence but possible)
- Separate procurement processes for different constituencies
- Could be duplicate release but more likely separate lots

This could be a downgrade - likely separate lots for different locations.

- downgrade: reduce severity or note likely innocent explanation
- withdraw: remove the lead entirely
